bead.title: Define profile power-policy model
bead.description: Add the catalog/service data model for named profiles as power-policy shorthand. Profiles must expand to effective MinPower/MaxPower and optional ranking preferences, not concrete candidate lists. Preserve compatibility metadata for older catalog references without making it the primary routing behavior.
bead.acceptance:
1. Profile definitions can express at least cheap, standard, and smart as effective power policies.
2. ResolveProfile/ListProfiles expose effective MinPower/MaxPower and compatibility target metadata where present.
3. Tests prove a profile does not resolve to a closed model set and that code-medium/code-high are not treated as target routing profiles.
4. go test ./internal/modelcatalog ./internal/config ./... -run "Profile|PowerPolicy|Catalog" passes.
